Changed the channel name: GA - Responsible Energy Infrastructure
I see a good few votes. What are people’s thoughts on this?

I have no opposition to the text but ideologically I am opposed to regulating things at this level. 

What this proposal does is require energy providers in nations to make publicly available documentation on the risks of the energy they provide as well as ways to contact authorities for more information and for member nations to educate their citizens on the different types of energy and their risks. It then enables the WA Disaster Bureau to enforce these mandates. 

I do not believe this is something requiring the intervention of the WA. Reasonable nations would already be doing these things, and the international harm of nations which choose not to do so is relatively low.
